fullContentHtml:
UPESSC UP Special TET Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Exam City Details for the post of Uttar Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test (UP Special TET 2026) Primary and Junior Level. Applications for the UPESSC UP Special TET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 05 September 2026, to 04 October 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 03 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPESSC UP Special TET Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 03 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 05 September 2026
  • Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 03 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : 24 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 31 October 2026
  • Answer Key : Notify Later
  • Result : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Exam City Details
  • Download Exam City / Admit Card Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Download Syllabus
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPESSC UP Special TET Exam City Details 2026?

UPESSC UP Special TET Exam City Details 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
